facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/dl.download_speech_parquet_single_lang: download a single language parquet file from 2M-belebele speech dataset to an output directory
facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/dl.download_speech_parquet_multi_lang: download multiple language parquet files from 2M-belebele speech dataset using the CLI with an output directory
facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/dl.download_all_speech_parquet: download all 74 language parquet files from the 2M-belebele speech dataset to a specified directory
facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/dl.list_available_speech_langs: list all 74 available language codes for the 2M-belebele speech dataset parquet files
facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/dl.run_dl_2mbelebele_cli: run the dl_2mbelebele CLI tool to download speech parquet files for specified languages to an output directory

facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/al.run_align_script: run the align script to align Belebele dataset with Fleurs audio data using stopes launcher
facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/al.load_fleurs: load Fleurs dataset entries for a given language and index them by id with audio and metadata
facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/al.align_flores: align Flores passage information to each Belebele row by matching links and sentences for English
facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/al.find_flores: find matching Flores entries for a Belebele row by matching passage text against Flores sentences
facebookresearch_belebele/2M-belebele/al.AlignFleurs_call: add Fleurs entries to a batch of Belebele data by matching Flores IDs and remapping sentences
